summary: Candidate skill is a narrower, more specific variant of the existing peer skill 'Decorator-based Observability Instrumentation'. Both target the same semantic capability (decorator-based observability instrumentation), asset_type (session_skill), granularity (session), and method_family (decorator_pattern). The candidate focuses on @operation and @session decorators with async/generator support, while the peer covers a broader decorator ecosystem (@workflow, @agent, @operation). The peer skill is more comprehensive and already addresses the candidate's core objective. Merging the candidate into the peer avoids duplication and consolidates decorator instrumentation guidance into a single, authoritative skill.
